lint.description: Static analysis / linting for the adopting project's own stack.

unit-tests.description: Fast, isolated unit tests for the adopting project's own code (e.g. `dotnet test`, `npm test`). Used as a gate check by the implementation, QA and quick-change stages.

review.description: Automated review step — typically wired to invoke the code-review agent via `adf agent run code-review-agent`.

harness-tests.description: ADF's own Harness + adf-core test suite. Not part of any workflow gate; run it with `adf validate --stages harness-tests`.
